Delhi government withdraws work-from-home policy as West Asia tensions ease

The Delhi government has withdrawn its order mandating 50% work from home for employees and staggered office timings. This decision comes as geopolitical tensions in West Asia have eased. The policy was part of a broader winter pollution control plan, which included measures like requiring pollution under control (PUC) certificates for fuel and restricting certain vehicles.
